facts.name: previous_review_findings
facts.value: Round 1: manifest not bound to Base; dependency family required ADR-0026; lazy-dispatch boundary undefined; README family not in permitted paths; workflow-policy conflict; no baseline payload fixtures and missing model round-trip; OpenAPI and registry paths and component-key rules unlocked; definitions is a $defs library. Round 2: ADR-0026 not yet committed; manifest Base-source labeling inaccurate; CONTRIBUTING.md and schemas/README.md authority missing; compatibility-targets acceptance missing; /v1 equivalence needs baseline pre-validation; content_hash recomputation scope conflicted with prohibited records; OpenAPI component keys and registry structure need fixed machine-verifiable rules; 14 Pydantic models wording. Round 3: stale predecessor worktree prerequisite; branch name presented as evidence; strict model parity, immutable f36 snapshots, full OpenAPI embedding, exact offline drift-check, and Closeout ownership needed. Current rework: Fact.value must preserve integral 3.0 parity; all failure reporting must remain bounded and safe with unreadable corpus fixtures; diagnostic line breaks must be escaped; the snapshot digest manifest must lock its exact base and 14 paths; registry and migration target versions must reject booleans and non-integers. Revision 7: replace the approved-but-unsafe process-global FORMAT_CHECKER mutation with a local checker per Schema validator; a fresh-subprocess default-checker non-mutation regression is required.
